svg.text: Shortcuts + dynamic key lighting · AZERTY positions
Function map: these colors are not all active at the same time.
Then press and release the target
FN: blue idle · cyan held/guide · amber selecting · red Turbo · green hold · purple Game Mode
After 5 s without RGB: CAPS green when active · SCROLL amber when active
NUM on: white numpad + green NUM · NUM off: very dim white numpad
ESC stops Turbo · Fn + Enter replays the red wave · Fn + F1 returns control to Aurora
CAPS/NUM/SCROLL fallback respects live RGB, lighting Off and USB suspension.
Red Blade Full Size ISO · 4 media keys · Normal typing and media functions are preserved
